claim: Sections 1 and 3 + outreach email: commercial lines postings describe certificate/policy-change/contact-verification/AMS work, the role is 're-advertised across three towns at $30K–$85K', and postings 'advertise evenings off'.
problem: Both cited IdealTraits job pages now return HTTP 410 Gone (app.idealtraits.com/career/Oliver-L-E-Soden-Agency/270618IND and /338418gog), the dashboard.idealtraits.com/...15664765844ind link returns 404, and the Glassdoor listing returns 403. No Wayback snapshot exists for either IdealTraits URL. The audit's central evidence, and the email's core sentence, therefore cannot be re-opened by me or by the recipient, and the specific figures ($30K–$85K envelope, 'three towns', 'evenings off') are unverifiable. Note also that $30K–$85K spans two different posted bands, not one role's band.
fix: Re-source from a live listing or a saved copy before sending; otherwise rewrite as 'in recent postings (since closed)' and drop the $30K–$85K envelope and 'three towns' claim. If kept, state it as 'posted bands ranging from about $30K–$35K up to $50K–$85K'.

claim: 'Clients also have to pick the right portal from roughly 30 carrier claim and payment links.'
problem: The cited page (sodeninsurance.com/report-a-claim-pay-online/) lists 44 carriers, each with a claim and a payment link. 'Roughly 30' understates the page by about a third.
fix: Change to 'more than 40 separate carrier claim and payment portals'.

claim: 'Newer niche pages — contractor, marine, pickleball facility, nonprofit, cyber — multiply the questionnaires per submission.'
problem: page-sitemap1.xml and /niche-industries/ contain contractor/construction and trade pages, pickleball facility, boutique gym, nonprofit, janitorial and cyber liability, but no marine page on sodeninsurance.com. Marine is a John B. Wright (separate brand) specialty, so 'marine' is not one of Soden's newer niche pages.
fix: Replace 'marine' with 'HVAC/electrical/plumbing trades', or attribute marine to John B. Wright in a separate clause.

claim: 'a reply to about 97% of them' (opening paragraph).
problem: The cited Trustindex page shows the review list, replies, and a FAQ section (182 reviews, 5.0 average, 99% five-star) but publishes no reply-rate statistic. I could not find 97% anywhere on the page.
fix: Drop the figure or write 'and almost every review gets a reply, usually within a day', which the page itself supports.

claim: 'a 5.0 average across roughly 177 Google reviews' (audit) and 'a 5.0 across 177 Google reviews' (email).
problem: The cited Trustindex page currently states 182 reviews (Google plus Trustindex-collected), 5.0 average, 99% five-star; a Google-only count of 177 is not shown and the total no longer matches 177.
fix: Use 'a 5.0 average across roughly 180 reviews' in the audit and 'a 5.0 average across about 180 reviews' in the email.

claim: Section 2: coverage questions go to a licensed staffer, 'matching the "cannot bind via chat" notice already on the John B. Wright site'.
problem: johnbwright.com/client-portal resolves to the John B. Wright homepage. That page does load a chat widget (HelpOut), but no 'cannot bind/altered/cancelled via chat' disclaimer text appears anywhere in the fetched page source or text.
fix: Either verify the notice live and quote it exactly, or replace with 'which is the same rule your John B. Wright chat already implies' — or delete the sentence's reference to the notice.

claim: Section 3 impact: '$8,000–$25,000 a year of account manager time'.
problem: The underlying analysis derives this from 150–400 hours at roughly $32–$40/hr loaded, which yields $4,800–$16,000. The $25,000 upper bound is not reachable from the stated assumptions — it is roughly 55% above them.
fix: Restate as '$5,000–$16,000 a year' or widen the stated hours/rate basis (e.g. 150–450 hours at $32–$55/hr loaded) so the range follows from the assumptions.

claim: 'all of that service flows through one Account Management team in Jamesburg, covering Jamesburg, Little Silver and the Manasquan-based John B. Wright division.'
problem: The Jamesburg page says the office houses the entire Account Management department and the principals; it does not say that team services the Little Silver office and the John B. Wright division. That extension is the researcher's inference, presented here as fact.
fix: Frame it: 'your site says the entire Account Management team sits in Jamesburg — which suggests servicing for all three locations runs through one team.'

claim: 'the most standardized book' (marine/marina certificates at John B. Wright, Section 1 pilot).
problem: Relative standardization of the marine book is a judgment, not a published fact, and is stated flatly.
fix: Write 'likely the most standardized book' (inference) or 'the book with the most repeatable certificate wording, from what's public'.

claim: 'Quoting starts from one embedded web form with no upload path'.
problem: The page confirms a single embedded iframe form (go.sodeninsurance.com). The iframe's fields did not render for me, so 'no upload path' is unverified — loss runs could be requested inside that form.
fix: Hedge: 'one embedded web form, with no document upload step I could see from the outside'.

problem: The body (title through the 'Prepared from publicly available information' line, excluding the 'For the founder' section and Sources) is approximately 570 words, about 25% over the brief's ~450-word ceiling.
fix: Cut roughly 120 words — the intros to sections 1-3 and the three 'Why this works' bullets are the easiest trims; drop the bullets to one line each or merge sections 2 and 3's 'Now' paragraphs.

claim: Email opener: 'I've watched Soden grow from the Jamesburg office into three locations and the John B. Wright marine book'.
problem: Implies long first-hand acquaintance with the agency; the audit is prepared from public pages, so the framing risks reading as fabricated familiarity. Separately, 'Hal' is ambiguous — Hal Soden, Sr. and Hal Soden, Jr. are both principals on the Jamesburg page.
fix: Say 'I saw that Soden has grown from the Jamesburg office into three locations and the John B. Wright marine book' and address the principal as Hal Soden, Sr.
